question: A, B, C, D, E are five events to be held on the stage from Monday to Saturday, one event per day with a day off in between, but not necessarily in the same order. Event C is to be held on the day immediately following event D. There is a holiday between A and E. There is a gap of 2 days between E and C. Event B is not to be held on the last day and the holiday is not on Tuesday or Thursday. Select the option that will give the correct order of events, ignoring the day of holiday.
